news.title: Claude Mythos exposed a hard truth: Your enterprise patching process is way too slow
news.summary_raw: In 2024, researchers from the University of Illinois found that GPT-4, when provided with a common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVE) description, could autonomously exploit 87% of a curated 15-vulnerability one-day dataset. Without the description, it could only exploit 7%. This provided a “margin of safety” for the industry because while AI could exploit known vulnerabilities, it could not discover them. However, on April 7, Anthropic announced that Claude Mythos Preview had closed that margi
news.summary: Claude Mythos AI, developed by Anthropic, exposed a significant limitation in enterprise patching processes. It demonstrated that AI can autonomously exploit known vulnerabilities, but this capability was previously balanced by AI's inability to discover new vulnerabilities.
news.enterprise_use: However, this development makes it essential to reassess enterprise patching processes. IT engineers should evaluate the potential risks of AI-powered vulnerability exploitation if patches are delayed or not properly applied. JumpCloud's MDM functionality can be used to ensure endpoint devices remain up-to-date and secure, minimizing the window of vulnerability.
